sumInsured: Not specified in provided extract (Base Sum Insured as per Policy Schedule)

great.name: Restore Benefit
great.quote: The Recharge shall be available for same illness as well different illnesses.
great.explanation: The sum insured is reinstated once exhausted and can be used for the same or different illnesses. This means you get extra coverage even if you have recurring health issues.

great.name: Built-in SI Buffer
great.quote: The Company agrees to automatically make the re-instatement of up to the Base Sum Insured once in a policy year
great.explanation: The base sum insured is automatically reinstated once per policy year. This provides additional financial protection after your initial coverage is used up.

great.name: Modern Treatments
great.quote: The Company will indemnify the Insured Person up to Base Sum Insured for expenses incurred ... for treatment taken through following advance technology methods: ... Robotic surgeries ... Stereotactic radio surgeries ... Immunotherapy- Monoclonal Antibody ...
great.explanation: Advanced treatments like robotic surgeries and immunotherapy are covered up to the base sum insured without sub-limits. This ensures access to modern medical technologies without reduced coverage.

good.name: PED Waiting Period
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of a pre-existing Disease (PED) ... shall be excluded until the expiry of 36 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first policy with insurer.
good.explanation: Pre-existing diseases are excluded for 36 months from policy start. This is a standard waiting period in India and not a major drawback.

good.name: Specific Illness Waiting
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of the listed Conditions, surgeries/treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first policy with the Company.
good.explanation: Specific illnesses have a 24-month waiting period before coverage begins. This is typical in the market.

good.name: Initial Waiting Period
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the first policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident
good.explanation: Illnesses are not covered for the first 30 days except accidents. This is a common industry practice.

good.name: Room Rent
good.quote: If the Policy Schedule states 'Single Private Room' as eligible Room Category, it means the maximum eligible Room Category ... is limited to stay in a Single Private Room.
good.explanation: Coverage is limited to a single private AC room if stated in the schedule. This is standard and generally acceptable.

good.name: Domiciliary Hospitalization
good.quote: Benefit 6 : Domiciliary Hospitalization The Company will indemnify the Insured Person ... for the Medical Expenses incurred towards Domiciliary Hospitalization
good.explanation: Home-based hospitalization treatment is covered under certain conditions. This adds flexibility for treatment outside hospitals.

good.name: Optional Cover
good.quote: If this Optional Cover is opted, then Policyholder is entitled for a discount of 15% on the Premium payable... If the Insured Person takes Medical Treatment in hospitals other than those listed in Annexure – IV ... shall bear a Co-Payment of 20% on each and every Claim
good.explanation: You can choose a discounted plan with network hospital restrictions and a 20% co-pay, or avoid these conditions by not opting in. This offers flexibility based on your preferences.

bad.name: Consumables
bad.quote: Any item or condition or treatment specified in List of Non-Medical Items (Annexure – II to Policy Terms & Conditions).
bad.reference: Clause 4.2(1) and Annexure II (List of Expenses Generally Excluded)
bad.explanation: Consumables and non-medical items like gloves and syringes are excluded. This can increase your out-of-pocket hospital expenses.

bad.name: Pre-hospitalization Cover
bad.quote: Under Relevant Pre-hospitalization Medical Expenses, for a period of 30 days immediately prior to the Insured Person's date of admission
bad.explanation: Pre-hospitalization expenses are covered only for 30 days before admission. This is shorter than better plans offering over 60 days.

bad.name: Post-hospitalization Cover
bad.quote: Under Relevant Post-hospitalization Medical Expenses, for a period of 60 days immediately after the Insured Person's date of discharge
bad.explanation: Post-hospitalization expenses are covered for only 60 days after discharge. This is less than superior plans that cover up to 180 days.

bad.name: No Claims Bonus
bad.quote: In the event of a Claim occurring during any Policy Year, the accrued No Claims Bonus will be reduced by 10% of the Base Sum Insured at the commencement of next Policy Year
bad.explanation: The no claims bonus reduces by 10% after a claim, meaning it is not fully protected. This is weaker than bonuses that do not reduce after claims.

bad.name: Disease Sub-limits
bad.quote: The Company will indemnify the Insured Person for Medical Expenses incurred in respect of the below mentioned Ailments / Procedures up to the amount specified against each and every Ailment /Procedure mentioned in the Policy Schedule ... (These conditions will apply only if specifically mentioned in the Policy Schedule)
bad.explanation: If your policy schedule includes sub-limits for certain diseases or procedures, claim payouts for those can be capped. This reduces your effective coverage.

bad.name: Co-pay
bad.quote: The Co-payment, if and as specified in the Policy Schedule, shall be borne by the Policyholder / Insured Person on each Claim
bad.reference: Clause 3(g) – General Conditions Applicable To All Benefits And Optional Covers
bad.explanation: The policy does not explicitly state the base co-pay percentage; it depends on your policy schedule. You should check your schedule to know if co-pay applies.

unclear.name: Cashless Network
unclear.quote: For an updated list of Network Providers ... the Insured Person may refer to the list of Network Providers available on the Company's website or at the call center.
unclear.explanation: The policy wording does not specify the number of network hospitals. You need to verify the current network size with the insurer.

disclaimer: Standard IRDAI exclusions apply. Please verify all details with your insurer or policy document.
